requirements.multiclassing: preserved and summed; under-level characters are normalized without deleting secondary classes
requirements.alignment: Universal eight-axis covenant system v3.1; 81 titles use the first four axes and four additional axes control expression; traditional nine-box labels forbidden
requirements.pantheon: canonical 22 only, with active covenant pressure and resonance
requirements.classes: 22 canonical deity-bound merged classes and 66 subclasses; a selected class forces its assigned deity
requirements.races: 236-entry canonical register; ancestry never determines morality
requirements.dialogue: Dialogue Studio browser-safe core plus backend and combat-aware fallback using alignment, race, class, and covenant context
requirements.ruleset: D&D 5.5e: Universal Edition — Covenant Engine from universal_how_to_play.json
requirements.encounterBudget: Covenant Engine Threat Points; legacy adjusted XP is display-only
requirements.combat: alternating-side initiative, 3 Beats per turn, 1 Reaction; boss slots replace unrestricted legendary actions
requirements.time: Earth UTC remains world UTC; fixed local offsets with no DST; settlement overrides province, province overrides longitude-derived local time
requirements.calendar: 11 months of 30 days; 330-day civil year; leap day every 7 years; 330.15 Universal days equals 365.2422 Earth days
